customer_name: Guangdong Power Grid Customer Center (南方电网广东客服中心)
business_problem: Guangdong Power Grid's customer center needed to build a digital service operation from scratch that could handle online text support, modernize hotline IVR, and give agents a self-improving knowledge base instead of outdated search tools and fragmented customer-service workflows.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud privately deployed a full intelligent customer-service stack for Guangdong Power Grid Customer Center, covering online text service, hotline IVR transformation, and a unified intelligent knowledge base. The dialogue layer uses intent recognition, entity recognition, multi-turn conversation, and semantic understanding so the system can identify customer needs and route them to the right content service. Baidu then fine-tuned a power-sector customer-service large model using Guangdong Power Grid's domain data, which made the assistant better at energy-industry language and service cases. On the knowledge side, the unified intelligent knowledge base provides standard answers from enterprise corpora and continuously learns from historical bot conversations so its resolution quality improves over time. Together, these elements create a privately controlled service architecture that assists customers directly, shortens call handling, and pushes suggested responses to human agents when conversations need escalation.

solution_components.name: Intelligent Dialogue System
solution_components.role: Handles intent recognition, entity extraction, semantic understanding, and multi-turn interaction for Guangdong Power Grid's text and IVR customer-service channels.

solution_components.name: Intelligent Knowledge Base
solution_components.role: Maintains standard enterprise answers and continuously improves through machine-learning analysis of past customer-service conversations.

data_flow: Customers enter through online text service or hotline IVR, the intelligent dialogue system parses intent and entities, the power-domain model and knowledge base retrieve or generate the best answer, and escalated sessions can push response suggestions to agents while conversation history feeds later self-learning.
business_outcome: The customer center improved both self-service resolution and agent productivity, giving electricity customers faster answers while creating a more scalable and domain-specific service operation.
architecture_clues: The solution was privately deployed rather than run as a public SaaS service.
The power-sector large model was fine-tuned on Guangdong Power Grid's own customer-service data.
Historical bot conversations feed autonomous learning loops for the knowledge base.
evidence_quotes: Baidu AI Cloud privately deployed a complete intelligent customer-service workflow, transformed the hotline IVR system, and built a unified intelligent knowledge base for Guangdong Power Grid's customer center. (original: 百度智能云为南方电网广东客服中心提供了私有化部署的一系列智能客服相关产品和服务，为客服中心从0搭建了完整的智能文字客服服务流程，对客服中心的电话IVR服务系统进行了全面而彻底的改造，并提供了统一的智能知识库。)

The dialogue system relies on intent recognition, entity recognition, multi-turn dialogue, and semantic understanding to interpret customer requests. (original: 百度通过意图识别、实体识别、多轮对话、语义理解等关键技术，帮助客服系统准确的从用户输入内容中识别出意图及需求的关键信息。)
Guangdong Power Grid's own customer-service data was used to fine-tune a power-industry intelligent customer-service large model. (original: 结合广东电网优质能源行业客服数据进行大模型微调，形成电力行业智能客服大模型。)
The knowledge base can learn from historical conversations between users and the robot so it keeps improving its problem-solving ability. (original: 通过持续挖掘用户与机器人客服的历史会话进行自主学习，不断提高解决问题的能力。)

The service now handles 400,000 customers a month, covers 1,200 knowledge Q&As and 36 business scenarios, resolves 92% of cases, and improves agent efficiency by five times. (original: 智能在线客服月均服务客户40万人次；覆盖1200个问答知识，36个业务场景，智能客服整体解决率可达92%；...客服坐席接待效率提升5倍。)
